content: Gɑsɔ Gusunɔ u kɑ bɛsɛn sikɑdobɑ ɡɑri kuɑ nɔn dɑbinu kɑ swɑɑ dɑbinu sɑɑ win sɔmɔbun min di.
Adɑmɑ sɑnɑm dɑ̃ɑkim mɛni sɔɔ u kɑ sun ɡɑri kuɑ sɑɑ win Biin min di. Bii wiyɑ u hɑnduniɑ tɑkɑ kuɑ, Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nùn ɡɔsɑ u kɑ nùn ɡɑ̃ɑnu kpuro nɔmu bɛriɑ.

Win yiiko yɑ sɔ̃ɔsirɑmɔ win min di. Bii wi, u sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔn tii tiin weenɑsii, u mɑɑ bɑɑyere kpuro nɛni kɑ win ɡɑri dɑmɡii. Ye u tɔmbu sɑ̃rɑsiɑ ben torɑnun di u kpɑ, u dɑ u sinɑ wɔllɔ Gusunɔ dɑm kpuroɡiin nɔm ɡeuɔ.
Nɡe mɛ Gusunɔ u win Bii yĩsiru kɑ̃ te tɑ win ɡɔrɑdobɑɡinu kpɑ̃ɑru kere, nɡe mɛyɑ mɑɑ Bii win tii u Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdobɑ kere.
Kɑ ɡem, Gusunɔ u ǹ win ɡɔrɑdobɑn ɡoo sɔ̃ɔre u nɛɛ,

content.text: “Wunɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn Bii.
Gisɔrɑ nɑ kuɑ wunɛn tundo.”

content: N ǹ mɑɑ mɔ win ɡɔrɑdo ɡoo u kɑ yɑ̃ ye u nɛɛ,

content.text: “Kon ko win tundo,
u koo mɑɑ ko nɛn bii.”

content: Adɑmɑ sɑɑ ye u win Bii yerumɑ ɡɔriɔ hɑnduniɑ sɔɔ u nɛɛ,

content.text: “Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdobɑ kpuro bu yiiro bu nùn sɑ̃.”

content: Wee ye u ɡeruɑ win ɡɔrɑdobɑn sɔ̃. U nɛɛ,

content.text: “Gusunɔ u win ɡɔrɑdobɑ kuɑwɑ nɡe woo,
mɑ u win sɔm kowobu kuɑ nɡe dɔ̃ɔ yɑri.”

content: Adɑmɑ win Biin sɔ̃nɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: “Gusunɔ, bɑ wunɛn bɑndu swĩi sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Gemɑ ɑ kɑ wunɛn bɑndu nɛni.
A ɡeɑ kĩ mɑ ɑ kɔ̃sɑ tusɑ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ Gusunɔ wi u sɑ̃ɑ wunɛn Yinni u nun ɡɔsɑ.
U mɑɑ nun nuku dobu wɛ̃
ye u kɑ nun ɑye bɛɛrɛɡiru wɛ̃
te tɑ wunɛn kpɑɑsibuɡinu kpɑ̃ɑru kere.”
“Yinni, toren di wunɑ ɑ tem tɑkɑ kuɑ.
Wunɛn nɔmɑ ɑ mɑɑ kɑ wɔllu kuɑ.
Ye kpuro yɑ koo doonɑ ɑdɑmɑ wunɛ kɑɑ n wɑ̃ɑ.
Yɑ koo tɔkɔru ko nɡe yɑ̃nu.
Kɑɑ ye kure nɡe yɑberu.
Yɑ ko yɑ n mɑɑ kɔsimɔwɑ nɡe yɑ̃nu.
Adɑmɑ wunɛ, wunɑ mi, ɑ ǹ tɔkɔru mɔ̀.”

content: Gusunɔ kun mɑɑ win ɡɔrɑdobɑn ɡoo sɔ̃ɔre u nɛɛ,

content.text: “A sinɔ nɛn nɔm ɡeuɔ
sere n kɑ nun wunɛn yibɛrɛbɑ tɑɑreɑ.”

content: Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, mbɑ wɔllun ɡɔrɑdobɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ. Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ hundebɑ be bɑ Gusunɔ sɑ̃ɑmɔ. Berɑ u rɑ mɑɑ ɡɔri bu dɑ bu be bɑ koo fɑɑbɑ wɑ somi.
